referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A cinematic skyline panel carries a concise proposition and a gold specialist action before a dense, white editorial firm introduction. Centered small wordmark, low-contrast service/audience menus and a search/contact path on a narrow top bar. Confident serif section headings with readable sans paragraphs and compact uppercase taxonomy labels. The page sequence runs from skyline-led service opening to firm introduction with location image to audience question accordion toward insights collage, credential marks, dark footer. Skyline opening, practice-location image, case photography and editorial insight thumbnails supply the visual punctuation. Only transferable composition, hierarchy and service-routing mechanics are retained.

surfaces: warm gold and occasional sandstone service fields.

imageTreatment.mode: Skyline opening, practice-location image, case photography and editorial insight thumbnails supply the visual punctuation.

servicePresentation.pattern: Use audience questions to route the visitor to verified services, then present a compact audit/tax/advisory taxonomy and sector detail.
servicePresentation.interaction: direct, functional routes for verified services only

ctaPlacement.primary: Offer specialist enquiry in the opening and again after relevant service evidence, without repeating it on every card.
ctaPlacement.secondary: a useful service, portfolio or preparation path near the opening
ctaPlacement.early: primary and secondary actions should be visible near the first promise

motion.library: CSS or a small purposeful transition only if needed
motion.reducedMotion: all copy, imagery and actions visible statically

mobileRecomposition.strategy: Collapse the hero imagery behind legible text, turn service blocks and case samples into a one-column narrative, and preserve accordion labels as clear taps.
rules: keep source-specific hierarchy and decision sequence
use a 390 px single-column or deliberate two-column layout without overflow
keep touch actions and form labels visible

prohibitedPatterns: Do not carry over firm years, employee counts, client names, case work, registrations, credentials or original photography.
Source identity, exact wording, logos, people, photographs, fonts, badges, testimonials, numerical claims or locations as client assets.
Invented reviews, credentials, prices, guarantees, service areas, outcomes, response times or staff.
Generic SaaS cards that replace the observed composition, and decorative motion that hides service or contact information.
